"};
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),cv=$('rig'),overlay=$('bones'),octx=overlay.getContext('2d'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
let d,verts,idx,current='',start=performance.now(),frozen=0,paused=false,loaded=false,token=0,report=null,sourcePixels,frameImage,margin=0,lastFrame=-1,lastKey='';
const rad=a=>a*Math.PI/180,rotate=(p,c,a)=>{let x=p[0]-c[0],y=p[1]-c[1],s=Math.sin(rad(a)),q=Math.cos(rad(a));return [c[0]+x*q-y*s,c[1]+x*s+y*q]};
function geometry(){let v=[],tri=[],nx=d.xs.length,ny=d.ys.length;for(let y of d.ys)for(let x of d.xs)v.push(x/(d.width-1)*d.width,y/(d.height-1)*d.height);for(let j=0;j<ny-1;j++)for(let i=0;i<nx-1;i++){let a=j*nx+i,b=a+1,c=a+nx,e=c+1;tri.push(a,b,c,b,e,c)}verts=new Float32Array(v);idx=new Uint16Array(tri);}
function angles(m,t){const s=Math.sin(t*5),c=Math.cos(t*5),a={body:0,head:0,armLUpper:0,armLLower:0,armRUpper:0,armRLower:0,legLUpper:0,legLLower:0,legRUpper:0,legRLower:0};let dy=0;if(m==='idle'){a.body=1.5*Math.sin(t*2);a.head=-1.7*Math.sin(t*2);a.armLUpper=1.2*s;a.armRUpper=-1.2*s;}if(m==='wave'){a.body=-1.5;a.head=2;const sign=current.endsWith('side')?(current.startsWith('star')?1:-1):1;const arm=current.endsWith('side')?'armL':'armR';a[arm+'Upper']=-sign*(9+4*s);a[arm+'Lower']=-sign*(12+6*c);}if(m==='walk'){a.body=1.6*s;a.head=-1.1*s;a.armLUpper=8*s;a.armRUpper=-8*s;a.armLLower=3*c;a.armRLower=-3*c;a.legLUpper=-9*s;a.legRUpper=9*s;a.legLLower=5*Math.max(0,c);a.legRLower=-5*Math.max(0,-c);dy=-3*Math.abs(s);}if(m==='jump'){let k=Math.max(0,Math.sin(t*3.3));dy=-d.height*.047*k;a.armLUpper=12*k;a.armRUpper=-12*k;a.legLUpper=3*k;a.legRUpper=-3*k;a.legLLower=5*k;a.legRLower=-5*k;}return{a,dy};}
function transformations(m,t){const{a,dy}=angles(m,t);const body=p=>{const r=rotate(p,d.hip,a.body);return [r[0],r[1]+dy]};const root=p=>[p[0],p[1]+dy];let fn={body,head:p=>body(rotate(p,d.neck,a.head))};for(const limb of ['armL','armR','legL','legR']){const u=limb+'Upper',l=limb+'Lower';if(!d.bones[u])continue;const parent=limb.startsWith('arm')?body:root,base=d.bones[u][0],joint=d.bones[u][1];fn[u]=p=>parent(rotate(p,base,a[u]));fn[l]=p=>parent(rotate(rotate(p,joint,a[l]),base,a[u]));}return fn;}
function deform(m,t){if(m==='rest')return verts;const f=transformations(m,t),p=new Float32Array(verts.length);for(let i=0;i<verts.length/2;i++){let xy=[verts[2*i],verts[2*i+1]],x=0,y=0,sum=0;for(let j=0;j<d.names.length;j++){const w=d.weights[i][j];if(!w)continue;const q=f[d.names[j]](xy);x+=w*q[0];y+=w*q[1];sum+=w;}p[2*i]=x/sum;p[2*i+1]=y/sum;}return p;}
// CPU triangle rasterizer. Each output pixel samples the actual source texture through the deformed mesh.
function raster(p){const W=cv.width,H=cv.height,src=sourcePixels,dst=frameImage.data;dst.fill(0);for(let i=0;i<idx.length;i+=3){const ia=idx[i]*2,ib=idx[i+1]*2,ic=idx[i+2]*2,ax=p[ia]+margin,ay=p[ia+1]+margin,bx=p[ib]+margin,by=p[ib+1]+margin,cx=p[ic]+margin,cy=p[ic+1]+margin;const ux=bx-ax,uy=by-ay,vx=cx-ax,vy=cy-ay,det=ux*vy-uy*vx;if(Math.abs(det)<1e-5)continue;const minX=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Math.min(ax,bx,cx))),maxX=Math.min(W-1,Math.ceil(Math.max(ax,bx,cx))),minY=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Math.min(ay,by,cy))),maxY=Math.min(H-1,Math.ceil(Math.max(ay,by,cy)));const su=verts[ib]-verts[ia],sv=verts[ic]-verts[ia],tu=verts[ib+1]-verts[ia+1],tv=verts[ic+1]-verts[ia+1];for(let y=minY;y<=maxY;y++)for(let x=minX;x<=maxX;x++){const dx=x+.5-ax,dy=y+.5-ay,u=(dx*vy-dy*vx)/det,v=(ux*dy-uy*dx)/det;if(u<-.00001||v<-.00001||u+v>1.00001)continue;const sx=Math.max(0,Math.min(d.width-1,Math.floor(verts[ia]+u*su+v*sv))),sy=Math.max(0,Math.min(d.height-1,Math.floor(verts[ia+1]+u*tu+v*tv)));const si=(sy*d.width+sx)*4,di=(y*W+x)*4;if(src[si+3]){dst[di]=src[si];dst[di+1]=src[si+1];dst[di+2]=src[si+2];dst[di+3]=src[si+3];}}}ctx.putImageData(frameImage,0,0);}
function draw(m,t){if(!loaded)return;const p=deform(m,t);raster(p);octx.clearRect(0,0,overlay.width,overlay.height);octx.save();octx.translate(margin,margin);if($('showmesh').checked){octx.strokeStyle='#187f8b66';octx.lineWidth=.65;octx.beginPath();for(let i=0;i<idx.length;i+=3){const a=idx[i]*2,b=idx[i+1]*2,c=idx[i+2]*2;octx.moveTo(p[a],p[a+1]);octx.lineTo(p[b],p[b+1]);octx.lineTo(p[c],p[c+1]);octx.closePath();}octx.stroke();}if($('showbones').checked){const f=transformations(m,t);octx.strokeStyle='#087f84';octx.fillStyle='#fff';octx.lineWidth=3;for(const [n,b] of Object.entries(d.bones)){let a=f[n](b[0]),z=f[n](b[1]);octx.beginPath();octx.moveTo(...a);octx.lineTo(...z);octx.stroke();for(let q of [a,z]){octx.beginPath();octx.arc(...q,5,0,2*Math.PI);octx.fill();octx.stroke();}}}octx.restore();return p;}
function compare(){draw('rest',0);const b=ctx.getImageData(margin,margin,d.width,d.height).data,a=sourcePixels;let mismatch=0,fg=0,max=0;for(let i=0;i<a.length;i+=4){if(a[i+3]!==255)continue;fg++;let e=Math.max(Math.abs(a[i]-b[i]),Math.abs(a[i+1]-b[i+1]),Math.abs(a[i+2]-b[i+2]),Math.abs(a[i+3]-b[i+3]));if(e)mismatch++;max=Math.max(max,e);}return {foreground:fg,mismatch,max,triangles:idx.length/3,bones:d.names.length};}
async function load(){const n=++token;loaded=false;current=$('char').value+'-'+$('view').value;d=DATA[current];let im=new Image();im.src=IMAGES[current];await im.decode();if(n!==token)return;margin=Math.ceil(d.height*.12);cv.width=overlay.width=d.width+2*margin;cv.height=overlay.height=d.height+2*margin;const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=d.width;c.height=d.height;const x=c.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});x.drawImage(im,0,0);sourcePixels=x.getImageData(0,0,c.width,c.height).data;const ref=document.createElement('canvas');ref.width=cv.width;ref.height=cv.height;ref.getContext('2d').drawImage(im,margin,margin);$('ref').src=ref.toDataURL();frameImage=ctx.createImageData(cv.width,cv.height);geometry();loaded=true;report=compare();$('result').textContent='정지 메시 원본 비교: '+report.mismatch.toLocaleString()+' / '+report.foreground.toLocaleString()+' 픽셀 차이 · 본 '+report.bones+'개 · 삼각형 '+report.triangles.toLocaleString()+'개';start=performance.now();frozen=0;lastKey='';}
$('char').onchange=$('view').onchange=load;$('motion').onchange=()=>{start=performance.now();frozen=0;paused=false;$('pause').textContent='일시 정지';};$('reset').onclick=()=>{$('motion').value='rest';$('motion').onchange();};$('pause').onclick=()=>{if(!paused){frozen=(performance.now()-start)/1000;paused=true;}else{start=performance.now()-frozen*1000;paused=false;}$('pause').textContent=paused?'재생':'일시 정지';};
function tick(now){if(loaded&&now-lastFrame>35){const m=$('motion').value,t=paused?frozen:(now-start)/1000,k=[current,m,m==='rest'?0:t,$('showmesh').checked,$('showbones').checked].join('|');if(k!==lastKey){draw(m,t);lastKey=k;}lastFrame=now;}requestAnimationFrame(tick);}requestAnimationFrame(tick);load();window.textureRig={get report(){return report},get loaded(){return loaded},get current(){return current},frame:(m,t)=>{paused=true;frozen=t;$('motion').value=m;return Array.from(draw(m,t));}};
</script></html>
